notes: 8 configurations of 7 machines from 6 manufacturers (attocube, Montana Instruments, Quantum Design, kiutra, Quantum Design Oxford, Bluefors/AEM-Afore), none already in data/cryostats. Sourced absences: attoDRY800 magnet (attocube comparison table, attoDRY800(xs) column blank), OptiCool Flex magnet (Quantum Design: magnet removed / No Magnetic Field), attoDRY2100 vacuum (sample in He exchange gas: vacuum.available=false, pressure.base not_available). Options not fitted: magnets on CryoAdvance 50 (no field value published), kiutra (5/8 T solenoid; 8 T recorded), ProteoxMX (14 T solenoid recorded); kiutra magnetic shielding. Conservative values: attoDRY2100 base 1.8 K (spec 1.65-1.8 K) and 10 mK guaranteed stability; OptiCool vibration 10 nm and relative stability 0.2%; CryoAdvance clear aperture = 30 mm cold window. OptiCool Flex 200 mm diameter x 75 mm height is read from the printed "75 mm x 200 mm Volume" in the same height x diameter order as the 7 T model (84 x 89 mm = 84 mm tall, 89 mm diameter) and checked against the stated cavity of over 2,000 cm3 (200 x 75 mm gives 2,356 cm3, 75 x 200 mm would give 884 cm3). kiutra 50 mK-300 K range is quoted from its distributor Paeonia Bloch (republishing kiutra specifications); the base temperature comes from kiutra's own sheet. Keys without a source are kept as kind=unknown/install=unknown records and listed in not_found; pressure.base is the most common gap (optical cryostats and DRs rarely publish it). Tavily credits ran out during the search; WebSearch/WebFetch and direct page reads were used. accessed 2026-11-01.
